subject: general
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Secure
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Attack**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Secure"** means to make safe, protect, or guard something against danger or harm. (सुरक्षित करना) • **Example:** The bank has installed new security systems to secure its vaults. • **"Attack"** refers to an aggressive action against someone or something, typically with the intent to harm or damage. (हमला करना) • **Example:** The soldiers were prepared to attack the enemy at dawn. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Secure'** is **'Attack'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Attack**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Succeed** (सफल होना): To achieve a desired aim or result. • **Example:** He worked hard to succeed in his final exams. • **Save** (बचाना): To keep someone or something safe from harm or danger. • **Example:** The lifeguard saved the child from drowning. • **Trundle** (धीरे-धीरे चलना): To move or roll slowly and heavily. • **Example:** The old cart trundled down the bumpy road. 160:T145a,
